_comment: Made-up podcast shows for the podcast shots (run.sh section 2c, seed-podcasts.mjs). Each becomes <root>/<folder>/feed.json (feed.json v1) plus cover.jpg; every episode with a file gets a short silent mp3 and a fetch pin computed from it. `days_ago` is counted back from the run, `minutes` is the audio's length, `absent` leaves the file out (no fetch pin: not on the server), `follow` is followed by the listener in capture-web.mjs. All names and words here are invented.

shows.title: The Lantern Archive
shows.author: Saltmarsh Audio Theatre
shows.description: A new keeper inherits a lighthouse full of reel-to-reel tapes that nobody admits to recording. An audio mystery in weekly parts, best heard in order.

episodes.title: Trailer: Before the Light
episodes.description: Two minutes from the keeper's first night, and a voice on a tape that should be blank.

episodes.title: The Inventory
episodes.description: Mara counts the tapes, the lamps and the logbooks, and finds one more of each than the handover list says.

episodes.title: Reel Seventeen
episodes.description: A reel labelled with next week's date plays a storm that hasn't happened yet.

episodes.title: Fog Signal
episodes.description: The horn sounds on a clear night, and a fishing boat answers in a code nobody has used for fifty years.

episodes.title: The Keeper's Hand
episodes.description: The handwriting in the oldest logbook is Mara's own.

shows.title: Field Notes at Dawn
shows.author: Hedgerow Radio
shows.description: Five quiet minutes from the countryside every morning: the weather, the birds, and one small thing worth noticing on the walk.

episodes.title: The wren on the gatepost
episodes.description: A very small bird with a very loud song, and why it sings hardest in the cold.

episodes.title: Frost on the cabbages
episodes.description: The first hard frost, and the allotment holders who were ready for it.

episodes.title: A heron at the weir
episodes.description: Patience, as practised by a grey heron standing very still in fast water.

episodes.title: Rooks going home
episodes.description: Hundreds of rooks crossing the valley at dusk, all talking at once.

episodes.title: The last swallows
episodes.description: The wires by the barn are empty this morning. Where they go, and how they find their way back.

episodes.title: Fairy rings
episodes.description: A circle of mushrooms on the cricket pitch, and the fungus under it that is older than the club.

episodes.title: The beekeeper's last check
episodes.description: Closing the hives for winter with a beekeeper who talks to every colony.

episodes.title: Wind in the poplars
episodes.description: Why one row of trees sounds like rain when there isn't a cloud in the sky.

shows.title: The Slow Kitchen
shows.author: Larder & Lamp
shows.description: Long recipes for short evenings: one dish a week that mostly cooks itself, and what to do while it does.

episodes.title: A stew for the first cold week
episodes.description: Beans, a ham hock and four hours of not lifting the lid.

episodes.title: Bread that waits for you
episodes.description: An overnight loaf, mixed in five minutes before bed.

episodes.title: The patience of onions
episodes.description: Caramelising slowly, properly, and the soup it becomes.
